text_block_list.text:
Special Week asked me to watch her dance 
lesson, so when I arrived――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's the gist of it... Frankly 
speaking, how was my dancing?
choice_data_list: Was that a little awkward, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I guess that makes sense... I'm well aware 
that I'm still not very good at it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to be able to dance 
more properly!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live is where I convey my 
gratitude to everyone who supports me, so 
I want to dance well!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It might be strange to ask you, Trainer, 
but... is there any way I can get better 
at dancing?
choice_data_list:
Dancing energetically just like yourself 
is the best way.

Just dance with all your energy in your 
own style—that's what's best.
Dancing in sync with the music is key.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It might be strange to ask you, Trainer, 
but... is there any way I can get better 
at dancing?
choice_data_list:
Dancing energetically just like yourself 
is the best way.

Just dance with all your energy in your 
own style—that's what's best.
Dancing in sync with the music is key.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: True to myself... full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! Since I'm the one saying thank you, 
I have to do it my own way!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! I've gotta make sure I can move 
around a lot so I can express my gratitude 
with my whole body!

Afterward, Special Week threw herself 
freely into dance lessons that used her 
entire body.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Synchronizing with the music, is it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's true—an off-beat, out-of-sync dance 
just doesn't look good at all, does it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll have to listen closely 
to the music and make sure I can dance to 
it!

After that, Special Week focused entirely 
on listening closely to the music, working 
on a dance that matched the song.
